about_draft:
I help teams get dependable Excel work done, and I am looking for my next role as a Business Intelligence Analyst.

What I bring:
• I rebuilt a weekly sales report as a Power BI dashboard and cut the prep time from 4 hours to 30 minutes.
• I once sent a report without checking duplicate rows, and the totals were wrong until a teammate caught it.
• A 5-minute data check before sharing saves hours of explaining later.

What I write about: actionable tips, personal journey, career insights, industry trends.
Skills I use most: Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python.

If you are hiring for Business Intelligence Analyst, message me. I reply to every note.
